paragraphs: Cott Systems sells software for recording, imaging and searching land and court records. Its stated focus is the officials responsible for records management in local government.

One product handles cloud-based records management with anytime, anywhere access to an office's records. Another is a land records system for receiving, recording, storing and archiving records. There is also a court case management system. An eCommerce gateway provides the public with round the clock access to those records. Historical index books can be preserved and presented online. Beyond software, the company offers backfile document conversion, scanning, redaction, reindexing, microfilm and bindery and refurbishment services.

The company reports over 300 active systems across 21 states. It traces its work on solutions for managing public records back to 1888. Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, it is a privately held corporation that was recently brought into a larger software group. That group, Valsoft, was established in Canada in 2015 and acquires and develops vertical market software companies. The company also stays active in regional and national town, parish, county, clerk and recorder organizations across the United States.
